item.tib: nyams len ye shes lnga skor
item.coloph: nyams len ye shes lnga skor 'di/ skal ldan khyod la snyan du brgyud/ gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ skal pa ldan pa rigs kyi bu/ phyi ma'i don bsgrub ma rtogs pas/ skal ldan phal la bstan 'gyur na/ stag gdong dmar mo'i bya ra dam/ de ba'i gcig brgyud sa ma ya//
